── Deep Analysis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
We are on the right side of the one trade that matters and are volunteering to give it
back; the two alt shorts are on the wrong side of their own coins.

BTC 16902 — the winning side. +1.53% price, below EMA300 for its entire 6.9h life (1056
consecutive bars), 4h SHORT_BIAS, entered at meta_rsi 19.6 (deep oversold) and WON — which
is the useful correction to the naive "oversold shorts lose" reading: the structure was the
edge, not the RSI level. What is wrong is protection, not direction. The stop has not moved
in 6.9h while the same family handed back MFE 0.778 / 0.871 / 0.517 through manual stops
this week, and the trail-step condition got STRONGER every cycle (82 → 114 → 142 closes
≤67322) while remaining unexecuted at age=6. If I were opening this fresh today: yes, same
side, same structure — but with the stop below entry from minute one.

MNT 16904 — wrong side. Shorted 17 minutes after BOTH its own regime and the aggregate
flipped LONG_BIAS, and the coin has since told us more clearly: own conf 57.5 → 88.8, 6 of
8 recent 5m closes above entry. The winning side is LONG — MNT +0.64% over 16 candles,
breadth 56L vs 5S, and its prior same-side loss this week (-5.31%) proves the point. We
shorted it because the entry generator keys off BTC structure (below EMA300), which still
says down — the coin itself does not agree. Planned R:R on this one is also the weakest of
the book: TP 1.64% vs SL 1.10% = 1.49. If I were opening this fresh: no.

SOL 16903 — thesis faded, not broken. Entered ALIGNED at 04:27 (own SHORT_BIAS 81.7),
regime flipped LONG_BIAS at 05:00, then decayed to NEUTRAL 61.3 — a round trip to nowhere
while price sits 0.44% above entry. Manage it on the re-issued price condition above; do not
pretend the LONG_BIAS trigger still stands.

Fresh entry? No. Chop-bleed re-queried 05:53: 7d dollar share 93.5% ($4.19 of $4.48) ≥92 →
the next entry is statistically a never-armed loser. Armed 7d: 45T 38W 84.4% +$2.09 vs
never-armed 48T 5W 10.4% -$4.01 — $6.10 of the 7d swing sits between "reached +0.40% MFE"
and "did not", in BOTH directions. That is an arming problem, not a direction problem, and
it is why the BTC stop move outranks every other steer this cycle. The SUSHI pick above is
written as watchlist-only precisely because AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False and the same number says
a fresh entry is a coin flip.

Portfolio: fully short into a structure-down / momentum-up CHOP tape — exactly what
auto_trader calls MANAGE_ONLY and where our measured history says armed shorts round-trip
and never-armed entries die. No regime misalignment on BTC structure itself; the exposure
problem is correlation (3 shorts = one pump = three stops) plus two alt shorts whose own
coins are now long-biased. Opportunity cost is low (only 2 of the book is misaligned and
neither is bleeding yet); capital efficiency says fix the BTC stop before touching anything
else.
